findings.subject: @SET-03
findings.detail: S17 ends at night with the window black; S18 opens with cold grey daylight pouring through the same window. No storm build, time jump, or scene change is indicated — the join is marked continuous.

findings.subject: @PROP-02
findings.detail: S17 ends with the oil lantern lit and glowing amber on the table; S18 opens with the same lantern unlit. No action in either shot explains extinguishing or relighting.
